name: Airtable
one_liner: Web-based platform organized into bases, tables and records, with a Web API for reading and writing records.
auth_notes: Web API is used with a Personal Access Token (PAT) or OAuth token. Legacy API keys are deprecated; their Create base access was restricted to Enterprise.
access_notes: Web API is available on all plan types with call limits: Free 1000 calls per workspace per month, Team 100,000, Business and Enterprise unlimited. Organization admins may need to allowlist a token for organization-owned bases.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve PAT or OAuth on all plans; free tier capped at 1000 calls per month; 5 requests per second per base; enterprise org settings can hide bases.

identity.quote: Web/Browser, Mac app, and Windows app

auth.quote: when you authenticate with a Personal Access Token (PAT) or OAuth token

access.quote: Free plan - 1000 calls per workspace per month

api_surface.quote: Yes, the Web API has a rate limit of 5 requests per second, per base.
you will receive them in pages of up to 100 records at a time

mcp.quote: A Model Context Protocol server that provides read and write access to Airtable databases.

buildability.quote: Block API access to organization-owned bases and workspaces
